# `aitbc pool-hub status`

Check the pool hub health and status.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc pool-hub status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--pool-hub-url` | text | — | no | Pool Hub service URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc pool-hub status
```
